intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Marana for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Gingerbread 4x4 Display at The Ritz-Carlton, Dove Mountain) through December 30 (the same display), with the Marana Holiday Festival and Tree Lighting (December 5), Marana's nightly Christmas tree and musical light show (December 6 to 27) and the Live Nativity and Creche Festival (December 11 and 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Marana

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Marana
